incoming.explanation: The reconciliation synthesizes the untested Y-DNA discriminator as a standing question of the open program.
The untested discriminating Y-DNA kit is another of the three named levers.

sources.locator: FamilyTreeDNA Gurney surname project — Braintree kit 576097 (Big Y-700), terminal R-FTD83678 within R1b-M269 > P312 > DF19 > R-Z27053; public Discover haplotree, consulted June 2026

finding.statement: A direct-paternal-line Y-DNA discriminator that could test deep Gurney paternity independent of record survival is defined but untested. The FamilyTreeDNA Gurney project's Braintree Big Y-700 tester (kit 576097) sits at terminal SNP R-FTD83678 within R1b-M269 > P312 > DF19 > R-Z27053, a small continental-leaning north-west-European branch — compatible with but far too sparse and deep (pre-surname) to prove a Norman/continental deep origin. The discriminating comparison — whether a documented English-line Gurney shares the DF19 / R-Z27053 branch (the project's other R-M269 tester, kit 365744, and beyond it a recruit-and-test of a documented English line) — is unrun.
